shared_elements: compositions filling the surface with multiple figures
justification: Both surfaces carry outline-drawn, non-modelled figural imagery including human forms and curving hook-like lines, which is about as generic as pictorial correspondence gets. A is dominated by repeated schematic boats with vertical crew strokes, stick-figure people and cup marks arranged in loose horizontal registers, while B shows dense, elaborately curvilinear costumed figures with plume-like fans flanking a large central motif — completely different subject matter, complexity and compositional logic.
